test_title: PYST 28: SSC JE ME - Reasoning (Held on: 22 March 2021 (Evening)
subject: reasoning
question: A little boy is performing on stage. Pointing to him, his father, seated in the audience, told the woman sitting next to her, "The boy's grandmother's husband is your husband's wife's daughter's grandmother's husband." How is the woman sitting in the audience related to the mother of the man who is the father of the boy performing on stage?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e2a9b588787b910f88f390d997d50982d1b31fc6d58fc2d4ace803d6c3393e1.png] 

Based on the following data, the family tree diagram can be drawn as shown below,

The boy's grandmother's husband is your husband's wife's daughter's grandmother's husband

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/751ed3063fc4fd49b27a323826404771cc329df4e4062aaa3393575983bbfb21.png] 

Hence, Woman sitting in the audience is **"Daughter in law" **of the mother of Man.
